statement: Each random variable retains one persistent uniform prefix and unresolved comparisons refine it. The repaired dependency/postorder stack removes the positive-probability unbounded arithmetic-depth failure. The reviewed fair-bit/outward-arithmetic receiver terminates almost surely and returns exactly the fixed Maxwell integer-bin law; finite expected work additionally requires the explicit elementary-interval evaluator contract.

The reviewed zero-boundary-mass arguments establish almost-sure termination and exact integer-bin law under the stated fair-bit/arithmetic contract. They do not establish finite expected bit work; absent EXPECTED_BITS.md/certify.py remain an evidence gap.
assumptions: The repaired evaluator uses an explicit dependency/postorder stack; source SHA256 ba8202e02d8dd3e2fd85747ec726348ea78255337e2bffe6083d6d9ca6d41902 matches the actual completed review. Earlier recursion-depth failure and working review remain history. Finite expected fair-bit and bit work holds only for the constructed elementary-interval bit-machine contract at each fixed rational time and fixed catalogue. Actual Python-Flint/Arb expected CPU cost remains unproved. Exact integer bins, approximate equilibrium transient output and exact continuous hard-sphere output are distinct contracts; no practical all-solver advantage.
costs: Adaptive bit/arithmetic precision, occupied-child conditioning, reused factory thresholds, integer floors and explicit-stack DAG work remain paid.
Finite mean follows for the explicit elementary-interval machine at fixed time/catalogue; actual Arb/Python-Flint expected CPU complexity remains unproved.
The paid ordinary equilibrium approximation has a distinct finite-TV output contract.
contract.units: Exact integer-bin distribution, model time, fair-bit counts and outward-arithmetic precision; unrounded continuous output has a different contract.
contract.obstruction: Almost-sure termination does not prove finite expected bit/arithmetic work. The named EXPECTED_BITS.md and certify.py were absent at this snapshot, so that stronger claimed analysis is not acquired. Exact integer bins are not exact continuous-valued machine output or a hard-sphere receiver. Seeded runs, bounded observed precision and earlier NaN failures are diagnostics; diagnostic caps fail rather than return a fallback sample.
